G5515.definition: from the same as G5514; greenish, i.e. verdant, dun-colored

G5516.definition: the 22nd, 14th and an obsolete letter (G4742 as a cross) of the Greek alphabet (intermediate between the 5th and 6th), used as numbers; denoting respectively 600, 60 and 6; 666 as a numeral

G5517.definition: from G5522; dusty or dirty (soil-like), i.e. (by implication) terrene

G5518.definition: of uncertain derivation; a chœnix or certain dry measure

G5520.definition: from G5521; to be bilious, i.e. (by implication) irritable (enraged, "choleric")

G5521.definition: feminine of an equivalent perhaps akin to the same as 5514 (from the greenish hue); "gall" or bile, i.e. (by analogy) poison or an anodyne (wormwood, poppy, etc.)

G5522.definition: from the base of G5494; a heap (as poured out), i.e. rubbish; loose dirt

G5523.definition: of uncertain derivation; Chorazin, a place in Palestine

G5524.definition: from a compound of G5525 and G71; to be a dance-leader, i.e. (generally) to furnish

G5525.definition: of uncertain derivation; a ring, i.e. round dance ("choir"

G5526.definition: from G5528; to fodder, i.e. (generally) to gorge (supply food in abundance)

G5528.definition: apparently a primary word; a "court" or "garden", i.e. (by implication, of pasture) herbage or vegetation

G5529.definition: of uncertain origin; Chuzas, an officer of Herod

G5530.definition: middle voice of a primary verb (perhaps rather from G5495, to handle); to furnish what is needed; (give an oracle, "graze" (touch slightly), light upon, etc.), i.e. (by implication) to employ or (by extension) to act towards one in a given manner

G5531.definition: probably the same as the base of G5530; to loan

G5532.definition: from the base of G5530 or G5534; employment, i.e. an affair; also (by implication) occasion, demand, requirement or destitution
G5532.kjvUsage: business, lack, necessary(-ity), need(-ful), use, want.

G5533.definition: from a derivative of G5531 and G3781; a loan-ower, i.e. indebted person

G5534.definition: third person singular of the same as G5530 or G5531 used impersonally; it needs (must or should) be

G5535.definition: from G5532; to make (i.e. have) necessity, i.e. be in want of

G5536.definition: something useful or needed, i.e. wealth, price

G5537.definition: from G5536; to utter an oracle (compare the original sense of G5530), i.e. divinely intimate; by implication, (compare the secular sense of G5532) to constitute a firm for business, i.e. (generally) bear as a title
G5537.kjvUsage: be called, be admonished (warned) of God, reveal, speak.

G5538.definition: from G5537; a divine response or revelation

G5540.definition: from G5530; employment, i.e. (specially), sexual intercourse (as an occupation of the body)

G5541.definition: middle voice from G5543; to show oneself useful, i.e. act benevolently

G5542.definition: from a compound of G5543 and G3004; fair speech, i.e. plausibility

G5543.definition: from G5530; employed, i.e. (by implication) useful (in manner or morals)

G5544.definition: from G5543; usefulness, i.e. morally, excellence (in character or demeanor)

G5545.definition: from G5548; an unguent or smearing, i.e. (figuratively) the special endowment ("chrism") of the Holy Spirit

G5546.definition: from G5547; a Christian, i.e. follower of Christ

G5547.definition: from G5548; anointed, i.e. the Messiah, an epithet of Jesus

G5548.definition: probably akin to G5530 through the idea of contact; to smear or rub with oil, i.e. (by implication) to consecrate to an office or religious service

G5549.definition: from G5550; to take time, i.e. linger

G5550.definition: of uncertain derivation; a space of time (in general, and thus properly distinguished from G2540, which designates a fixed or special occasion; and from G165, which denotes a particular period) or interval; by extension, an individual opportunity; by implication, delay
G5550.kjvUsage: + years old, season, space, (X often-)time(-s), (a) while.

G5551.definition: from a presumed compound of G5550 and the base of G5147; to be a time-wearer, i.e. to procrastinate (linger)

G5553.definition: diminutive of G5557; a golden article, i.e. gold plating, ornament, or coin

G5554.definition: from G5557 and G1146; gold-ringed, i.e. wearing a golden finger-ring or similar jewelry

G5555.definition: from G5557 and G3037; gold-stone, i.e. a yellow gem ("chrysolite")

G5556.definition: from G5557 and πράσον (a leek); a greenish-yellow gem ("chrysoprase")

G5557.definition: perhaps from the base of G5530 (through the idea of the utility of the metal); gold; by extension, a golden article, as an ornament or coin

G5558.definition: from G5557; to gild, i.e. bespangle with golden ornaments

G5559.definition: probably akin to the base of G5530 through the idea of handling; the body (properly, its surface or skin)

G5560.definition: apparently a primary word; "halt", i.e. limping

G5561.definition: feminine of a derivative of the base of G5490 through the idea of empty expanse; room, i.e. a space of territory (more or less extensive; often including its inhabitants)
G5561.kjvUsage: coast, county, fields, ground, land, region.

G5562.definition: from G5561; to be in (give) space, i.e. (intransitively) to pass, enter, or (transitively) to hold, admit (literally or figuratively)
G5562.kjvUsage: come, contain, go, have place, (can, be room to) receive.

G5563.definition: from G5561; to place room between, i.e. part; reflexively, to go away

G5564.definition: diminutive of G5561; a spot or plot of ground
G5564.kjvUsage: field, land, parcel of ground, place, possession.

G5565.definition: adverb from G5561; at a space, i.e. separately or apart from (often as preposition)

G5566.definition: of Latin origin; the north-west wind

G5567.definition: probably strengthened from ψάω (to rub or touch the surface; compare G5597); to twitch or twang, i.e. to play on a stringed instrument (celebrate the divine worship with music and accompanying odes)

G5568.definition: from G5567; a set piece of music, i.e. a sacred ode (accompanied with the voice, harp or other instrument; a "psalm"); collectively, the book of the Psalms

G5569.definition: from G5571 and G80; a spurious brother, i.e. pretended associate

G5570.definition: from G5571 and G652; a spurious apostle, i.e. pretended pracher

G5571.definition: from G5574; untrue, i.e. erroneous, deceitful, wicked

G5572.definition: from G5571 and G1320; a spurious teacher, i.e. propagator of erroneous Christian doctrine

G5573.definition: from G5571 and G3004; mendacious, i.e. promulgating erroneous Christian doctrine

G5574.definition: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to utter an untruth or attempt to deceive by falsehood

G5575.definition: from G5571 and a kindred form of G3144; a spurious witness, i.e. bearer of untrue testimony

G5576.definition: from G5575; to be an untrue testifier, i.e. offer falsehood in evidence

G5578.definition: from G5571 and G4396; a spurious prophet, i.e. pretended foreteller or religious impostor

G5580.definition: from G5571 and G5547; a spurious Messiah

G5581.definition: from G5571 and G3686; untruly named

G5582.definition: from G5574; a fabrication, i.e. falsehood

G5584.definition: from the base of G5567 (compare G5586); to manipulate, i.e. verify by contact; figuratively, to search for

G5585.definition: from G5586; to use pebbles in enumeration, i.e. (generally) to compute

G5586.definition: from the same as G5584; a pebble (as worn smooth by handling), i.e. (by implication, of use as a counter or ballot) a verdict (of acquittal) or ticket (of admission); a vote

G5587.definition: from a derivative of ψίθος (a whisper; by implication, a slander; probably akin to G5574); whispering, i.e. secret detraction

G5588.definition: from the same as G5587; a secret calumniator

G5589.definition: diminutive from a derivative of the base of G5567 (meaning a crumb); a little bit or morsel

G5590.definition: from G5594; breath, i.e. (by implication) spirit, abstractly or concretely (the animal sentient principle only; thus distinguished on the one hand from G4151, which is the rational and immortal soul; and on the other from G2222, which is mere vitality, even of plants: these terms thus exactly correspond respectively to the Hebrew H5315, H7307 and H2416)
G5590.kjvUsage: heart (+ -ily), life, mind, soul, + us, + you.

G5591.definition: from G5590; sensitive, i.e. animate (in distinction on the one hand from G4152, which is the higher or renovated nature; and on the other from G5446, which is the lower or bestial nature)

G5594.definition: a primary verb; to breathe (voluntarily but gently, thus differing on the one hand from G4154, which denotes properly a forcible respiration; and on the other from the base of G109, which refers properly to an inanimate breeze), i.e. (by implication, of reduction of temperature by evaporation) to chill (figuratively)

G5595.definition: from the base of G5596; to supply with bits, i.e. (generally) to nourish

G5596.definition: diminutive from a derivative of the base of G5597; a crumb or morsel (as if rubbed off), i.e. a mouthful

G5597.definition: prolongation from the same base as G5567; to triturate, i.e. (by analogy) to rub out (kernels from husks with the fingers or hand)

G5598.definition: the last letter of the Greek alphabet, i.e. (figuratively) the finality

G5599.definition: a primary interjection; as a sign of the vocative case, O; as a note of exclamation, oh

G5600.definition: the subjunctive of G1510; (may, might, can, could, would, should, must, etc.; also with G1487 and its comparative, as well as with other particles) be
G5600.kjvUsage: + appear, are, (may, might, should) be, X have, is, + pass the flower of her age, should stand, were.

G5601.definition: of Hebrew origin (H5744); Obed, an Israelite

G5602.definition: from an adverb form of G3592; in this same spot, i.e. here or hither

G5603.definition: from G103; a chant or "ode" (the general term for any words sung; while G5215 denotes especially a religious metrical composition, and G5568 still more specially, a Hebrew cantillation)

G5604.definition: akin to G3601; a pang or throe, especially of childbirth

G5605.definition: from G5604; to experience the pains of parturition (literally or figuratively)

G5606.definition: perhaps from the alternate of G5342; the shoulder (as that on which burdens are borne)

G5608.definition: middle voice from an apparently primary ὦνος (a sum or price); to purchase (synonymous with the earlier G4092)

G5610.definition: apparently a primary word; an "hour" (literally or figuratively)
G5610.kjvUsage: day, hour, instant, season, X short, (even-)tide, (high) time.

G5611.definition: from G5610; belonging to the right hour or season (timely), i.e. (by implication) flourishing (beauteous (figuratively))

G5612.definition: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to "roar"

G5613.definition: probably adverb of comparative from G3739; which how, i.e. in that manner (very variously used, as follows)
G5613.kjvUsage: about, after (that), (according) as (it had been, it were), as soon (as), even as (like), for, how (greatly), like (as, unto), since, so (that), that, to wit, unto, when(-soever), while, X with all speed.

G5614.definition: of Hebrew origin (H3467 and H4994); oh save!; hosanna (i.e. hoshia-na), an exclamation of adoration

G5615.definition: from G5613 and an adverb from G846; as thus, i.e. in the same way
G5615.kjvUsage: even so, likewise, after the same (in like) manner.

G5616.definition: from G5613 and G1487; as if
G5616.kjvUsage: about, as (it had been, it were), like (as).

G5617.definition: of Hebrew origin (H1954); Hosee (i.e. Hoshea), an Israelite

G5618.definition: from G5613 and G4007; just as, i.e. exactly like

G5619.definition: from G5618 and G1487; just as if, i.e. as it were

G5620.definition: from G5613 and G5037; so too, i.e. thus therefore (in various relations of consecution, as follow)
G5620.kjvUsage: (insomuch) as, so that (then), (insomuch) that, therefore, to, wherefore.

G5621.definition: diminutive of G3775; an earlet, i.e. one of the ears, or perhaps the lobe of the ear

G5622.definition: from a derivative of the base of G5624; usefulness, i.e. benefit

G5623.definition: from the same as G5622; to be useful, i.e. to benefit

G5624.definition: from a form of G3786; helpful or serviceable, i.e. advantageous
